DiskVault image backup CLI

  dvault backup <repo> <source>... [--full] [--job name] [--machine PCname] [--keep N] [--password P] [--comment text]
                      [--crash-consistent] (do not use VSS writers) [--vss-full] (VSS full backup = truncate logs)
                      [--offline] (read directly without a snapshot; automatic in WinPE)
                      [--shadow ID[,ID]] (read those volumes from existing shadow copies; list with dvault shadows)
      source: C: / \\?\Volume{...}\  (from a VSS snapshot; requires administrator rights)
              system                  (entire disk containing Windows, for bare-metal restore)
              physical:N              (entire physical disk N, for bare-metal restore)
              image.img               (volume image file)
              image.img@offset:length (part of an image file)
              disk:disk.img           (disk image: all partitions + layout)
              shadow:ID               (one existing shadow copy: that volume only)
  dvault list <repo>
  dvault info <repo> <point>
  dvault verify <repo> [point|all]
  dvault restore-volume <repo> <point> <vol> <out.img|\\.\X:> [--sparse]
  dvault restore-disk <repo> <point> <out.img|\\.\PhysicalDriveN> [--disk N] [--size size] [--yes]
                      [--resize auto | 3=max | 3=80GB,4=1GB]   (resize partitions; NTFS only)
                      [--gap 2=300MB,...] (insert free space before a partition to move its start)
  dvault ls <repo> <point> <vol> [path]
  dvault extract <repo> <point> <vol> <path> <output folder>
  dvault prune <repo> --keep N
  dvault volumes
  dvault shadows                         (list existing shadow copies, e.g. System Restore points)
  dvault media --iso out.iso | --usb N  [--app publish folder] [--no-drivers] [--drivers folder]
  dvault media --uninstall-adk           (remove the Windows ADK and the WinPE add-on)
  dvault recover                         (interactive bare-metal restore for the recovery environment)
  dvault selftest [work folder]

  point is a restore point name (prefix match allowed) or latest. The password can also be set with the DVAULT_PASSWORD environment variable.
